output.message: Welcome, Ines! Your supply at Hillcrest Farm Cottage starts on 2026-12-18 on our time-of-use plan, with 100% renewable electricity backed by guarantees of origin: no community scheme reaches Eastmere yet, and we will tell you when one does. What your turbine exports is paid at 0.082 EUR per kWh. Your first bill follows a month later, paid by direct debit.
